verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's own spec page omits TDP, process node, and any power-envelope data, and the community thread explicitly notes it's 'difficult to evaluate efficiency claims (work per watt) without' TDP data. No independent battery-life benchmarks or confirmed fanless/thin-and-light designs are cited—only vague marketing phrases like 'legendary leap in performance' and unverified 'multi-day battery life' hearsay from a promotional video, with reviewers urged to 'wait for independent reviews.' The one shipping design mentioned (ASUS Ascent QN10) is a mini-PC, not a thin/fanless/all-day-battery laptop.
